interpretation: These are ASR hypotheses and text-comparison error rates, not ground-truth transcripts or a pronunciation score. Errors can arise from the recognizer, the synthesized speech, or text conventions. A low WER/CER does not establish correct stress, homograph sense, pronunciation, naturalness, or timing. A high WER/CER does not by itself prove a TTS error. Human listening is required.
normalization: Unicode NFC; casefold; remove apostrophes and zero-width joiners; replace other punctuation/symbols with spaces; collapse whitespace; preserve Unicode letters, combining marks and digits. No spelling repairs, number/date/time expansion, transliteration, or correction of the deliberate input anomalies. WER uses whitespace-separated words; CER uses Unicode code points excluding whitespace (not grapheme clusters, so Telugu vowel signs count separately).

model.revision_source: Hugging Face cached snapshot directory; no network query

decoding.note: Reference text is not supplied as a decoding prompt.
